The second out-of-range registry lookup is unreachable: the first range check or successful original 0x4db6e0 growth has included the same index, and no call or bound write occurs before the repeated check. Original instruction review confirms the compared index and bounds cannot differ.

Only the unreachable second out-of-range lookup can enter this continuation. In addition, original 0x4db6e0 allocation failure faults in 0x4dc680 at [EBP+4] with EBP zero rather than returning zero; original lower and upper growth failure probes confirmed the null read.
